reaction.episode: CORRECTION episode through Oct 30 (data fresh, not stale): SPX 7,580.07, -3.37% from its 120-day high, -1.52% below its 50-day but +3.7% above its 200-day; SMH 522.49, -22.2% from its high and sitting BETWEEN_ZONES, while NVDA 204.64 sits in Zone 1; VIX 19.42 at its 5-day high with no rollover and HY OAS 3.23 calm. Mechanical capitulation tally is 2 of 4 — zone reached, bottom not confirmed — and the tape extended the fall midday Oct 31 (QQQ -3.16%, SPY -1.59%).
reaction.invalidation: The Watch stance is wrong if a credit event arrives (HY OAS above 4%), if VIX sustains above 25, or if SPX closes below its 200-day near 7,310 with SMH breaking Zone 2 ($470) — any of those turns a correctable washout into a bear-market regime where Zone 2 is not a buy level at all. It is also wrong in the other direction if SMH reclaims and holds above $580–600 with the tally at 3 of 4, which would mean the correction already bottomed without a Zone 2 print.

ladder.response: Deploy Tranche A (25% of new money) into the Zone 2 names per the deployment ladder — this is the first pre-committed buy, and it requires both the zone print and tally confirmation, not the print alone.
ladder.trigger: SMH closes into Zone 2 ($470–505) or NVDA closes into Zone 2 ($175–185) AND the mechanical tally reaches 3 of 4

ladder.response: Treat it as the trap case: do not chase, do not add, and trim any Zone 1 probe exposure into the strength — the failure zone is where the first bounce goes to die.

ladder.response: Stand down: no tranche deployment at any zone print — the correction frame is broken, the ladder is void, and new money stays in bills until a new regime read is written.

ladder.response: Confirmed-bottom re-entry: advance the ladder to Tranche B/C conditions per the deployment plan — only a confirmed bottom, not a bounce, unlocks the larger tranches.

reaction.trapRisk: The pivot-and-fail scenario is the live risk: a sharp first bounce off Zone 1 into the SMH $580–600 / SPX $7,750–7,820 failure zone will look like the bottom and invite chasing. Entries change accordingly — no chasing the first bounce, no sizing on RSI alone, no add until the failure-zone retest gives its verdict; a probe, if taken at all, is small, in Zone 1 names only, and gets trimmed into failure-zone strength rather than added to.

strategyPosture: Watch, not buy: the correction is real and the AI complex is washed out against growing revenue, but the bottom is unconfirmed at 2 of 4 on the mechanical tally, NVDA is only in Zone 1, and the tape is still falling midday Oct 31 (QQQ -3.16%). New money stays in bills; the only live decision is whether Zone 2 prints arrive with tally confirmation.

The read stays rotation only while HY OAS stays contained and SPX holds above its 200-day; a credit crack would reclassify this theme overnight.

themes.counterRead: A revenue-vs-price gap is an opportunity only if the multiple stops compressing — and nothing in the tape says it has: SMH fell 6.98% on Oct 30 alone, NVDA is only in Zone 1 ($200–210), and the episode tally is 2 of 4 with no VIX rollover and no volume-climax reversal. Data is ahead of price, but price is still falling, so the gap is a watchlist, not an entry — the entries belong to Zone 2 prints ($470–505 SMH / $175–185 NVDA) with tally confirmation, not to catching the first bounce.

themes.counterRead: Oversold is a condition, not a signal. The narrative that this washout is the bottom is ahead of the data by two missing confirmations, and chasing the first green day into the SMH $580–600 / SPX $7,750–7,820 failure zone is the trap case. Patience is the position: the tally, not the RSI, decides when a probe becomes an add.

The volume-climax reversal is not confirmed — SMH volume was 1.99x its 20-day average but the close sat in only 46% of the day's range. themes.counterRead: Calm credit is what keeps this a correction and the ladder's zones valid — it is also the tripwire. The 10-year falling while equities fall is the market pricing slower growth, not a rescue; if HY OAS breaks 4% the correction thesis voids and the zone ladder with it. The midterm elections on Nov 3 (MEDIUM signal, 6 headline hits in the input) are the near-term catalyst that could move either leg.
